name: trustguard
description: NeuralTrust for Cursor: TrustGuard AI firewall (hooks) plus TrustGate MCP Gateway tools. One plugin for security and aggregated MCP access.

TRUSTGATE_MCP_URL.title: TrustGate MCP URL
TRUSTGATE_MCP_URL.description: Full MCP endpoint from the console Connect tab, e.g. https://{host}/{consumer-slug}/mcp. Required to enable the MCP Gateway.

TRUSTGATE_MCP_API_KEY.title: TrustGate MCP API key
TRUSTGATE_MCP_API_KEY.description: Consumer API key for X-AG-API-Key. Leave empty when the consumer uses OAuth (Cursor will open the login flow). Not the TrustGuard tgk_… collector key.

TRUSTGATE_GATEWAY_SLUG.title: TrustGate gateway slug
TRUSTGATE_GATEWAY_SLUG.description: Optional X-AG-Gateway-Slug for hybrid / private data planes. Leave empty on SaaS when the host already identifies the gateway.
